initial_inventory.title: build: fix SM70-only builds broken by activation_kernels.cu and its act-quant ops

metadata.title: build: fix SM70-only builds broken by activation_kernels.cu and its act-quant ops
metadata.body:
## Why this is not duplicating existing work

Searched open PRs for `activation silu sm70` / `silu_and_mul_quant`: no
existing PR addresses this. Related open PRs (#897, #1031, #1157) are
unrelated SM70 kernel/model work.

## Problem

`activation_kernels.cu` uses bf16 packed intrinsics that CUDA only exposes
for `__CUDA_ARCH__ >= 800`, but it is included unconditionally in
`VLLM_EXT_SRC`, and `torch_bindings.cpp` registers
`silu_and_mul_quant` / `persistent_masked_m_silu_mul_quant` unconditionally.
On SM70-only builds this breaks in two ways:

1. **Link failure**: the file is compiled, hits the SM80-only intrinsics
   problem, and if excluded instead, `_C.abi3.so` fails to load with
   undefined symbols (ImportError at server start).
2. **Silent corruption**: if the file compiles for Volta, the
   `silu_and_mul_quant` device path computes wrong values there, and
   `vllm/compilation/passes/fusion/act_quant_fusion.py` binds that kernel
   into compiled graphs → **silent generation corruption at temperature > 0
   with speculative decoding** (DFlash2/MTP draft paths). This matches the
   report in #1269.

Micro-test of the SM70-compiled op (single GPU, ~1 min):

```python
import torch, vllm._C
torch.manual_seed(0)
dev, d = "cuda:0", 256
x = (torch.randn(8, 2 * d, device=dev, dtype=torch.float16) * 2.0)
scale = torch.tensor(1.7, device=dev, dtype=torch.float32)
out = torch.empty(8, d, device=dev, dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn)
torch.ops._C.silu_and_mul_quant(out, x, scale)
ref = (torch.nn.functional.silu(x[:, :d].float()) * x[:, d:].float()
       * scale).to(torch.float8_e4m3fn)
diff = (out.float() - ref.float()).abs()
print("max abs diff:", diff.max().item())
print("mismatches >0.5:", (diff > 0.5).sum().item(), "/", ref.numel())
# observed on V100: max abs diff 24.0; 924 / 2048 wrong; wrong elements
# are consistently ~1/3 of the reference value
```

## Fix (follows the existing `VLLM_REGISTER_BASIC_ACTIVATION_IN_C` pattern)

- Detect SM80+ presence from `CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES` (`_VLLM_HAS_SM80`).
- Exclude `activation_kernels.cu` from `VLLM_EXT_SRC` when no SM80+ target
  is present (its DeepGEMM fp8 MoE paths are runtime-dead on pre-SM80).
- Compile out the two op registrations via
  `VLLM_REGISTER_DEEPGEMM_MOE_OPS` so `_C` still links.
- Make the act_quant fusion pass tolerant of the op being absent (`hasattr`
  guard, same pattern already used for the nvfp4 op) so the fusion is
  simply skipped.

## Test commands and results (2× V100-32GB, SM70-only, `TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST=7.0`, CUDA 12.8, gcc-13)

```bash
pip install -e . --no-build-isolation --no-deps   # EXIT=0
python -c "import vllm._C"                         # OK, no undefined symbols
nm -D vllm/_C.abi3.so | grep -cE 'silu_and_mul_quant|persistent_masked_m_silu_mul_quant'
# 0 (registrations compiled out)
```

- `vllm serve` boots on 2× V100 TP2 with DFlash2 speculative decoding;
  `GET /health` 200.
- Coherent generation across 6/6 samples at temperature 0.6/0.7 with the
  drafter active (previously intermittent ASCII/loop corruption).
- Throughput at parity with our pre-regression production build
  (single-stream 175.3 tok/s, 4-concurrent aggregate 109.0 tok/s,
  TPOT 9.21 ms).

## AI assistance

This PR was prepared with AI assistance on our rig; all measurements were
run and verified by the submitter (SabaTech-dev, https://sabatech.dev).

Related: #1269

🚀

**Validation on the real target (upstream main @ `4d57473db6`, this branch):**

- `pip install -e . --no-build-isolation --no-deps` (SM70-only,
  `TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST=7.0`, CUDA 12.8, gcc-13): **EXIT=0**
- `nm -D vllm/_C.abi3.so | grep -cE 'silu_and_mul_quant|persistent_masked'` → **0**
  (registrations compiled out; `_C` loads cleanly)
- Same gated pattern validated end-to-end on our fork build: `vllm serve`
  boots on 2× V100 TP2 with DFlash2, 6/6 coherent generation samples at
  temperature 0.6/0.7 (previously intermittent corruption), throughput at
  parity with our pre-regression production build.

The `act_quant_fusion.py` guard follows the same `hasattr` optional-op
pattern the file already uses for `silu_and_mul_nvfp4_quant`, so the
`kFp8StaticTensorSym` fusion is simply skipped when the op is absent
(behavior proven: weeks of clean production with a csrc that lacked the op).

Marking ready for review.

Reviewed the complete three-file patch against current main. Two architecture-selection problems need correction before the build fix can merge; I am preparing a targeted fix and will validate the SM70 build/import path on 54633.

[P1] Select supported targets from CUDA_ARCHS, which this project derives from the requested Torch -gencode flags, rather than CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES. Those are separate inputs in this build; using CMake's detected/default architecture can omit activation_kernels.cu and both operators even when the requested wheel includes SM80+. Validate SM70-only, SM80-only, and mixed target lists.

nodes.body: [P1] Operator existence does not qualify this fusion on the current device. A mixed SM70/SM80+ wheel still registers silu_and_mul_quant globally, so this condition enables the unsupported path on a V100. Gate this fusion on the current device's SM80+ capability as well as operator availability, and cover the mixed-wheel/V100 case.
